beats.headline: The basement under the town hall
beats.text: Hump Town's town hall, and a good number of the Dromedarian guards are not Dromedarians. In the basement is Wynne, held as collateral, and Wynne is willing to say who has been working on him. Henrik: to look at, a regular level-30 camel who shows some sort of ID at the back door; underneath, a changeling. What he wants out of Wynne is a spell that will put flesh on Quetzalcoatlus, and the method for getting it has been to drug him and come to him in borrowed faces, until the next dose may kill him. Crawlers from the subterranean quadrant appear at the boundary, and at Wynne's own begging one of them puts him down before any of it concludes.

beats.headline: He explains the collateral
beats.text: Carl and Princess Donut sit down with Henrik, charmed, and he explains how collateral works here, which is the local economy in miniature: Wynne held against the truce with the gnomes, and an ambassador, Leon the Commissar, who comes to inspect and casts a spell to make sure the collateral has not been swapped for a changeling. The next inspection is due in two days. How the code between the two sides actually works, he does not volunteer, and nobody in the room expects him to.

beats.headline: The delegation to the gnomes
beats.text: The plan walks out of the hall in a line: Carl, Princess Donut, Firas, Louis, a reanimated Wynne, and a Henrik who is Katia Grim doing his voice, not very well. They meet Leon, the Gnome Negotiator, and present Wynne as a man in urgent need of healing. Princess Donut announces herself as the healer and asks for passage onto the Wasteland in exchange. Leon will take Wynne and the healer and nobody else; the cat will not go without her manservant.

beats.headline: The body in the submarine
beats.text: Henrik of Hump Town, changeling, is dead, and has been for some time. Katia Grim runs into the flooded submarine to get away from a sharktopus, and Carl finds the body already sitting in there with its piece of the Gate of the Feral Gods still on it. One magically linked pocket watch, recovered. Also on him: a note recording that Quetzalcoatlus can be put down with an electric shock. Whatever else he was doing, he was still working that problem right up to the finish of him.
